_about: Corrections read by eye on the page, for one-off faults a heuristic would not fix without harm elsewhere. Keyed by volume. 'merge': article ids joined to the article before them. 'split': a piece that opens at the paragraph on page p containing 'at' (the paragraph is split there if need be). 'title', 'subtitle', 'section', 'author': by article id. 'drop': a line on page p beginning with 'text' (a running head the OCR spoiled). 'running_heads': the volume's running heads, where the OCR spoils them past matching. 'index' / 'index_add' / 'index_drop': the volume index corrected by the page. 'repairs': per volume ('fix': a reading to give; 'keep': a word to leave). '_repairs' applies to every volume. Every correction is listed in the volume's QA report.
